description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for IPC transport, including connection management, message sending and receiving, subscription handling, and resource management functions used in inter-process communication within a specific SDK.

methods.name: transport_malloc_msg
methods.description: Allocates memory for a message, potentially using custom transport buffers.

methods.name: transport_realloc_msg
methods.description: Reallocates memory for a message with a specified size.

methods.name: transport_free_msg
methods.description: Frees memory used by a message, potentially using custom transport buffers.

methods.name: transport_connect
methods.description: Establishes an IPC connection to a specified host and port.

methods.name: transport_establish
methods.description: Sets up an IPC server channel on a specified host and port.

methods.name: transport_pub_register
methods.description: Registers as a publisher on a given channel.

methods.name: transport_sub_register
methods.description: Registers as a subscriber on a given channel.

methods.name: transport_get_shutdown_sock_readfd
methods.description: Retrieves the shutdown socket descriptor for a given socket.

methods.name: transport_close
methods.description: Shuts down and closes an IPC channel.

methods.name: transport_subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to specific event topics on a socket.

methods.name: transport_publish
methods.description: Publishes a JSON event to all subscribers.

methods.name: transport_send
methods.description: Sends an IPC message with optional timeout.

methods.name: transport_recv
methods.description: Receives an IPC message with optional timeout.

methods.name: transport_sendmsg
methods.description: Sends an IPC message with a control block and timeout.

methods.name: transport_recvmsg
methods.description: Receives an IPC message with a control block and timeout.

methods.name: transport_abortmsg
methods.description: Aborts a pending message transfer by shutting down the control.

methods.name: transport_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down all pending IPC sender messages.
